Recorded claim:
`lib/utils.mjs` is the shared subprocess runner. Wait for child-process `close`, not `exit`, whenever captured stdout/stderr supplies a Git revision or failure log: `exit` can occur before stream delivery. Persisted Patch Update state under `~/.tb-tools/patch-sessions` exposes `status`, `error`, `output`, `originalHash`, and `currentHash`; preserve `error.output` rather than replacing the repository-update transcript. [Task 3]
